New this week (Nov 2 to Nov 8, 2026): Bryan Adams "How's It Goin", Lil Baby "Fresh", Kings of Leon "O My Beloved", Rex Orange County "Dream Fatigue", Skepta "The Fork and Knife", James Blunt "Airplane Mode", Duki "A Veces Solo Me Divierto", Passenger "Wild Love" and Vianney "Les évadés".

Bryan Adams is the biggest name of the week with 31.3M Spotify monthly listeners. 131 albums came out this week in the playcount.fm catalog. Skepta's The Fork and Knife is his first solo album since 2019's Ignorance Is Bliss.

On the charts: Tate McRae "Housewife" held No.1 on the Spotify global weekly chart (36.3M streams, week ending Nov 5). Biggest climber: Tame Impala "Dracula" jumped 97 places to No.87. New on the chart: ILLIT "You’re Under Arrest" (No.81), Bobby "Boris" Pickett "Monster Mash" (No.99), SHEAN "ako ang bagyo" (No.132).

Which new album are you playing first? 👇 Rate them on playcount.fm
